description: This file contains the VoiceWakeRecognitionDebugSupport enum with static methods for logging, matching, and summarizing voice wake word detection transcripts, along with associated data structures.

methods.name: shouldLogTranscript
methods.description: Determines whether a transcript should be logged based on logger level, previous log, and timing.

methods.name: textOnlyFallbackMatch
methods.description: Attempts to match a transcript as a text-only wake word command using provided triggers and configuration.

methods.name: transcriptSummary
methods.description: Generates a summary of a transcript including whether it is text-only and the count of segments.

methods.name: matchSummary
methods.description: Provides a string summary of a match result, including gap and command length.
